notes.title: An Honest Update Game Dev Isn’t Always Easy 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

I’m excited to share honest devlog 2.0 with you all. my most honest update yet. 

Here’s what you’ll find:

Our Origin Story: From a humble stick-man sketch to our fully animated red bird.

Animation Spotlight: A peek inside our massive state tree (hundreds of clips for one character!).

New Feature Reveal: Try out the floating ability I’m most proud of.

Real Talk: The ups, the downs, and the big question… did I make the right choice?

Looking Ahead: What would you like to see in Devlog 3.0? Your feedback really guides this project.



Watch the full update here: 


[previewyoutube="TkvBAljZ3e0;full"][/previewyoutube]



And if you’ve been enjoying the journey so far, please add us to your wishlist.

every single wishlist fuels this dream. 

Thank you for your support, and see you in Devlog 3.0!
— Maik
